facts.fact: 开头：过去一小时里，Sam 和新朋友们靠 Paradise 白金通行证插到每个水上项目队伍最前面。
facts.anchor: he and his new friends had used it to budge to the front of the line of every water ride in Macaw Falls.

facts.fact: 中段：一名 Lookout 找到 Max，称其为 Jones 先生，指出他几小时前就错过了报到时间。
facts.anchor: “Mr. Jones, you missed check-in hours ago,” he said to Max.

facts.fact: 揭露：Sam 想起广告，Dianne 与 Mitchell Jones 正是建造这座度假村的夫妇，也是 Avery 和 Max 的父母。
facts.anchor: Dianne and Mitchell Jones, repeatedly welcomed guests to Paradise, a special getaway they’d built for families

facts.fact: 转折：Simone 通过广播宣布暴风雨将至，为安全起见关闭水上乐园和其他游乐设施。
facts.anchor: Looks like that storm is upon us, Thrill Seekers! For your safety, we will be closing the water park and other rides

facts.fact: 关键动作：Max 走员工专用通道，不到五分钟把高尔夫球车开到水上乐园另一处。
facts.anchor: Max had found the network of employee-only access roads and used them to drive to another part of the water park

facts.fact: 中段：Max 带 Sam 与 Avery 来到新型项目 Silverback 面前——位于十五层机械大猩猩体内的坠落式滑道。
facts.anchor: “There she is! The Silverback! Thrill Harbor’s newest waterslide!” Max said, gazing up at the towering structure in awe.

facts.fact: 数字：Max 说 Silverback 下落最高时速接近五十七英里，且全场只有他们三人。
facts.anchor: The top speed on the drop is insane. Like almost fifty-seven miles per hour.

facts.fact: 结尾：Sam 尚未决定，脚下的活板门突然消失，只听得自己的尖叫与 Silverback 的轰鸣将他吞没。
facts.anchor: Suddenly the floor beneath him vanished. Then all he could hear was his own screams
